definitions.explanation: The logical flow or coherent sequence of an argument, explanation, or course of action. Implies things should proceed in a reasonable, orderly manner.

definitions.gloss: proper course of action; right way; proper procedure
definitions.explanation: The correct or socially expected way of handling a situation. Implies there is a right process to follow.

examples.english: Please explain in a logical, coherent manner.

notes:
USAGE:
{筋道|すじみち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to organize logically) and {筋道|すじみち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧ (to be logical/reasonable) are the most important collocations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筋道|すじみち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to organize logically; to lay things out coherently)
- {筋道|すじみち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧ (to be logical; to make sense)
- {筋道|すじみち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧ (to follow proper procedure)
- {筋道|すじみち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}った→通る：01243_tooru⟧ (well-reasoned; logical)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{論理|ろんり}→論理：06026_ronri⟧: logic — more academic and formal
- ⟦{道理|どうり}→道理：10400_douri⟧: reason; principle — focuses on natural justice or moral principle
